title: Vacation Under the Volcano
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie race to save a Roman scroll as Vesuvius erupts! 维苏威火山喷发时，杰克和安妮拼命去抢救一卷古罗马书卷！

q.en: What is the title of the lost story that Morgan asks Jack and Annie to find, written in Latin?
q.zh: 摩根让杰克和安妮去寻找的那篇失落的、用拉丁文写的故事，标题是什么？

options.en: The Strongest Man in the World

explain.en: The Latin title is "Vir Fortissimus in Mundo," which means "The Strongest Man in the World" — a lost tale about the hero Hercules.
explain.zh: 拉丁文标题是“Vir Fortissimus in Mundo”，意思是《世界上最强壮的人》——一个关于英雄赫拉克勒斯的失落传说。

q.en: Which research book does Morgan hand Jack before they travel to ancient Italy?
q.zh: 在前往古罗马之前，摩根交给了杰克哪一本参考书？

explain.en: Morgan hands Jack a book called Life in Roman Times, whose cover shows a Roman town with people in tunics and sandals.
explain.zh: 摩根交给杰克一本叫《罗马时代的生活》的书，封面上是一座古罗马城镇，人们穿着长袍和凉鞋。

q.en: On what date did Mount Vesuvius erupt and bury Pompeii?
q.zh: 维苏威火山喷发、掩埋庞贝城是在哪一天？

options.zh: 公元 79 年 10 月 31 日
公元 79 年 7 月 4 日
公元 79 年 8 月 24 日
公元 79 年 3 月 15 日

explain.en: Jack reads that on August 24, A.D. 79, Mount Vesuvius erupted into a deadly volcano and buried the town of Pompeii.
explain.zh: 杰克读到，公元 79 年 8 月 24 日，维苏威火山猛烈喷发，掩埋了庞贝城。

q.en: In the forum, who warns Jack and Annie by crying "The end is near!"?
q.zh: 在广场上，是谁冲着杰克和安妮喊“末日将至！”来警告他们的？

options.en: a frightened temple priest dressed all in white
options.zh: 一位身穿白衣、惊慌失措的神庙祭司

options.en: an old soothsayer in a black cloak
options.zh: 一位披黑斗篷的老预言家

explain.en: An old woman in a black cloak with wild gray hair points at them and rasps "The end is near!" She is a soothsayer who sees the future.
explain.zh: 一位灰发蓬乱、披黑斗篷的老妇人指着他们沙哑地喊“末日将至！”她是一位能预见未来的预言家。

q.en: To protect themselves from falling pumice and ash, what do Jack and Annie wear on their heads?
q.zh: 为了挡住落下的浮石和火山灰，杰克和安妮把什么顶在头上？

options.en: pillows tied on with their belts
options.zh: 用腰带绑在头上的枕头

options.en: heavy bronze battle helmets with red crests
options.zh: 带红缨的沉重青铜战盔

explain.en: They grab pillows from the couches and tie them onto their heads with the belts from their tunics to shield against the falling pumice.
explain.zh: 他们从躺椅上抓起枕头，用长袍上的腰带绑在头上，挡住掉落的浮石。

q.en: Besides the volcano, what strange signs does the soothsayer say are happening in Pompeii?
q.zh: 除了火山，女预言家说庞贝城还出现了哪些奇怪的迹象？

options.en: the river has turned bright red and all the crops in the fields have died
options.zh: 河水变红，田里的庄稼全都枯死了

options.en: the streams dried up, birds flew away, and rats left
options.zh: 溪水干涸、鸟儿飞走、老鼠出逃

options.en: the fish have disappeared from the sea

explain.en: The soothsayer tells Annie that all the streams have dried up, all the birds have flown away, and even the rats have left the town.
explain.zh: 女预言家告诉安妮，所有的溪水都干涸了，鸟儿全都飞走，连老鼠也离开了庞贝城。

q.en: Where do Jack and Annie find the lost scroll — what kind of building is it?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮是在哪里找到那卷失落的卷轴的——那是什么样的建筑？

options.en: the great Temple of Jupiter on the hill
options.zh: 山坡上宏伟的朱庇特神庙

explain.en: The soothsayer points them to the villa of Brutus, a large house at the end of the street where the scrolls are kept in a room off the garden.
explain.zh: 女预言家指向街尽头布鲁图斯的大别墅，卷轴就保存在花园旁边的一间屋子里。

q.en: When the giant gladiator from the ancient story saves them, what does he shout?
q.zh: 当古老故事里的巨人角斗士救起他们时，他大喊了什么？

options.en: Run as fast as you can to the tree house!
options.zh: 用最快的速度跑回树屋去！

explain.en: The huge gladiator lifts Jack and Annie to safety and booms "Run! Before it's too late!" — the ancient story of Hercules has saved them.
explain.zh: 巨角斗士把杰克和安妮举到安全的地方，大吼“快跑！不然就来不及了！”——正是赫拉克勒斯的古老故事救了他们。

q.en: What does Morgan tell Jack and Annie about what happened to most of the people of Pompeii?
q.zh: 关于庞贝城大多数人遭遇了什么，摩根告诉了杰克和安妮什么？

options.en: they moved together to the city of Rome the very next day
options.zh: 第二天他们一起搬到了罗马城

options.en: all of them were lost forever in the great eruption of the volcano
options.zh: 他们全都在那场火山大喷发中永远消失了

options.en: they sailed far away together on a trading ship
options.zh: 他们一起乘商船远航而去

options.en: most of them escaped before the city was fully buried
options.zh: 大多数人在城市被完全掩埋前逃走了

explain.en: Morgan says most of the people of Pompeii did escape, and the city was not completely buried by ash until the next day.
explain.zh: 摩根说，庞贝城大多数人确实逃了出去，直到第二天城市才被火山灰彻底掩埋。

q.en: In ancient Roman times, what were "books" written on?
q.zh: 在古罗马时期，人们把“书”写在哪里？

explain.en: Romans wrote their "books" on scrolls of papyrus paper, using pens made of small reeds and ink from the black ink of octopuses.
explain.zh: 罗马人把“书”写在纸莎草纸卷轴上，用芦苇小笔和章鱼墨汁来书写。
